title: Zesty Briny Norwegian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Norwegian stew featuring beef stock cubes and sous-vide cooking, perfect for a flexitarian diet. This dish is a nostalgic and comforting meal option.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef cubes with salt and black pepper.
Place the beef cubes in a large sous-vide bag and seal.
Cook the beef in the sous-vide machine for 24 hours.
Chop the onions, carrots, and celery into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté the chopped onions, carrots, and celery in a little water until they are tender.
Add the pickled mustard greens, beef stock cubes, and water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer.
Add the cooked beef, potatoes, and salt to the pot.
Simmer the stew for 30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
